correctness.rationale: The claim is a finite exact classification. An independent least-unused-vertex recursion enumerated every perfect matching of the 16 labeled vertices exactly once and returned 2,027,025=15!! matchings. Independently enumerating all nondecreasing 8-tuples from the 15 nonzero vectors and XOR-filtering at zero returned 20,295 admissible multisets, and the two profile sets agreed exactly. Re-tallying multiplicities produced the sixteen claimed realization counts with frequencies (15,210,105,1365,735,420,1890,840,840,3360,105,3360,2520,1575,2520,435); exactly 15 profiles had multiplicity one, all constant, and the least nonconstant multiplicity was four.
risks: The result is only the dimension-four finite census; no higher-dimensional inference is proved.
sources: Independent exact exhaustive enumeration of matchings and admissible XOR-zero profiles

value.rationale: This is the complete quantitative refinement of the first nontrivial fully solved BGS dimension: every admissible request profile is classified by its exact number of realizations, and the sharp uniqueness-versus-at-least-four gap supplies a natural robustness invariant rather than an arbitrary slice.
risks: The contribution is finite and computational rather than a general-dimensional formula.
